— Plutarque

description:

— Emil Michel Cioran

— Melvin Gallant

description:

— Paul Léautaud

description:

— Félix Leclerc

description:

— Thalès

name: assets/10stamp.png

description:

— William Shakespeare

name: assets/11stamp.png

— Eugène Guillevic

name: assets/12stamp.png

description:
